visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 has mostly text/formulas and avoids major positional diagram errors while preserving the correct area computation, whereas Lesson 2 repeatedly depicts the circles as concentric annuli/bullseyes rather than nested circles sharing a common point, making its central visuals conceptually and positionally misleading.

interactivity.rationale: Both lessons have no available gate specs or plan JSON, so neither shows any functional checkpoints or input-accepting questions and they are indistinguishable on interactivity.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 2 has clear, coherent, naturally paced narration with math spoken intelligibly, while Lesson 1 is severely garbled with many nonsensical phrases and pronunciation defects that make the audio essentially incomprehensible.

sync.rationale: Both lessons lack any beat/timing visual cue data, making their visual-narration synchronization indistinguishable and impossible to compare on this dimension.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 gives a coherent, mostly correct derivation of the shaded area sum and final answer 64, whereas Lesson 1 is essentially unintelligible and fails to explain the mathematics, though Lesson 2 does inaccurately describe the circles as concentric/common-center instead of merely sharing a common point.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 has a clean, centered, consistent visual style with legible text and no major UI artifacts, while Lesson 1 is repeatedly marred by persistent subtitle/control overlays, a visible red cursor, crowded footers, and clutter despite otherwise readable slides.

aggregator.explanation: Lesson 2 is the clear overall winner. Although Lesson 1 is preferred on visual accuracy because Lesson 2 misleadingly depicts the circles as concentric/bullseye-like rather than sharing a common point, Lesson 2 wins the higher-impact dimensions of narration quality, concept accuracy, and polish with very high confidence. The interactivity and sync agents found no meaningful difference because both lessons lacked relevant checkpoint/timing data. Overall, the strong high-confidence advantages for Lesson 2 in comprehensibility, mathematical explanation, and presentation outweigh its visual-diagram flaw.
